shellCommands.command: (npm run start -- --port 3100 > /tmp/next-server.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s http://localhost:3100/ -o /tmp/home.html && grep -o 'name="\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*"' /tmp/home.html | sort -u

curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST http://localhost:3100/ \
  -F '$ACTION_ID_408b6a40202da0e2feb8d4ba4cc494fc41b549d485=' \
  -F 'title=The Dispossessed' \
  -F 'author=Ursula K. Le Guin' \
  -F 'notes=Anarres chapters are the best part.' \
&& cat data/books.json

ID=d5315fb5-f56c-4d9b-a1f9-c06e38fdd24f
echo "--- home lists book:"; curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o "books/$ID\|The Dispossessed\|Currently reading" | sort -u
echo "--- detail page:"; curl -s "http://localhost:3100/books/$ID" | grep -o "The Dispossessed\|Ursula K. Le Guin\|Anarres chapters are the best part.\|Currently reading" | sort -u
echo "--- finish action id:"; curl -s "http://localhost:3100/books/$ID" | grep -o 'name="\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*"' | sort -u

ID=d5315fb5-f56c-4d9b-a1f9-c06e38fdd24f
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'finish POST: %{http_code}\n' -X POST "http://localhost:3100/books/$ID" \
  -F '$ACTION_ID_4000e6de51beb3bda08ea7f084b832c4617e0d1fb8=' \
  -F "id=$ID"
echo "--- json status:"; grep -o '"status": "[a-z]*"\|"finishedAt": "[^"]*"' data/books.json
echo "--- detail now says:"; curl -s "http://localhost:3100/books/$ID" | grep -c 'Mark finished'
echo "--- 404 check:"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3100/books/nope

pkill -f 'next start' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
(npm run start -- --port 3101 > /tmp/next-server2.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4
echo "--- after restart, finished list has book:"; curl -s http://localhost:3101/ | grep -o 'The Dispossessed' | head -1
pkill -f 'next start' 2>/dev/null; rm -f data/books.json /tmp/home.html; echo cleaned
tail -5 /tmp/next-server2.log 2>/dev/null; ls data/ 2>/dev/null; pgrep -f 'next start' || echo "no server running"

curl -s http://localhost:3101/ | grep -o 'The Dispossessed\|>Finished<' | sort -u; kill 423 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -f data/books.json /tmp/home.html /tmp/next-server*.log; pgrep -x next-server || echo "server stopped, test data removed"

mkdir -p data && printf '[{"id":"abc-123","title":"Persist Test","author":"A. Uthor","notes":"still here","status":"reading","addedAt":"2026-08-26T00:00:00.000Z","finishedAt":null}]' > data/books.json
(npm run start -- --port 3102 > /tmp/next3.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4
curl -s http://localhost:3102/ | grep -o 'Persist Test' | head -1
curl -s http://localhost:3102/books/abc-123 | grep -o 'still here' | head -1
pgrep -f next-server | xargs -r kill; sleep 1; rm -f data/books.json /tmp/next3.log; echo done
ls data/ 2>/dev/null; curl -s -o /dev/null -m 2 http://localhost:3102/ && echo "server still up" || echo "server down"; rm -f data/books.json /tmp/next3.log; ls data/ 2>/dev/null; echo ok
